verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only goal-level agent runs, such as a natural-language task passed to runs.create, plus the option to connect your own Playwright/Puppeteer code over CDP. Neither is a documented set of granular act/click/type primitives that target described elements and survive selector or layout changes. Whole-task agents are an adjacent capability, and raw CDP access is a developer building block, so neither earns credit here.
